text:
samira: hey folks! landed my first tiny change in data-ingest. quick questions before i tidy the branch: 1) do we prefer rebasing onto main or merging main into feature branches? 2) i accidentally committed generated mock files (mocks/*). how do i remove them cleanly? 3) commit message format? sorry for the barrage 😅

rachel: welcome Samira :wave: short answers: 1) rebase onto main for small/single-author branches (keeps history clean). if it's a long-lived branch used by many people, merge main. 2) remove generated mocks with git rm --cached and add them to .gitignore, then force-push. 3) conventional commits are preferred: type(scope): brief summary (ticket).

tom: adding: when you rebase, please do an interactive rebase (git rebase -i origin/main) and squash fixup commits so the PR is easy to review. For generated mocks: 
```bash
# remove generated files from repo but keep locally
git rm -r --cached mocks/
# ensure we ignore them going forward
echo "mocks/" >> .gitignore
git add .gitignore
git commit -m "chore: remove generated mocks from repo"
```
then force-push your branch.

samira: thanks! will do. any rules about keeping the PR under a certain size? my change touched a couple of serializers as well.

rachel: we try to keep PRs reviewable within ~20 minutes. If touching many serializers means reviewers need to follow data flow across files, consider splitting into a behavior change PR + a separate serializers cleanup PR. Also include a short summary in the PR body explaining why the change is safe and how to test locally.

infra-bot: infra-bot: note: CODEOWNERS requires approval from @team-data for anything under services/data-ingest/*.json

tom: good call — add at least one reviewer from CODEOWNERS. If it's urgent, ping the oncall channel. Also run `make test-ci` locally; it mirrors CI runs. If lint autofixes change many files, split formatting into its own PR.

samira: got it. one more: commit message body style — should we include a short Reason/Why section?

rachel: yes please. Helpful template we use in PRs: one-line summary, blank line, "Why: <short reasoning>" and "Testing: <how you tested>". Example: 

"fix(ingest): avoid double-write when retrying (ENG-4021)"

"Why: intermittent double-writes observed under retry. This ensures idempotency by..."

"Testing: unit + integration local run; added test for retry path."

ci-bot: ci-bot: build #4120  queued

tom: final nit: our merge strategy is squash-and-merge by default. if you want to preserve a clean series of commits, say so in the PR and request a no-squash merge (rare). Otherwise squash.

samira: perfect. i'll clean the mocks, rebase, squash the noise commits, add the Why/Testing sections, and tag CODEOWNERS. will ping when CI is green — thanks y'all! :raised_hands:
